The surname '''Dowtry''' can refer to the following people:

*[[Bar Dowtry]] - a cabinetmaker from the [[Two Rivers]].
*[[Buel Dowtry]] - a fletcher from [[Emond's Field]] and grandfather of Jonneth.
*[[Elam Dowtry]] - a young man from Emond's Field.
*[[Jonneth Dowtry]] - a young man from Emond's Field, grandson of Buel, and an [[Asha'man]] [[Soldier (Asha'man)|Soldier]] at the [[Black Tower]].
